ko.title: 2027년 COLA가 다가옵니다: 9월 물가상승률이 사회보장 연금 인상액을 결정하는 방법

segments.src: Every October, millions of Social Security beneficiaries wait for one number: the cost-of-living adjustment, or COLA, that will apply to their monthly benefit starting in January.
segments.tr: 매년 10월이면 수백만 명의 사회보장 연금 수급자들은 1월부터 월 수령액에 적용될 생활비 조정분(COLA)이라는 하나의 숫자를 기다립니다.

segments.src: This year, the final piece of that calculation arrives with the September Consumer Price Index (CPI) report.
segments.tr: 올해, 그 계산의 마지막 조각은 9월 소비자물가지수(CPI) 보고서와 함께 도착합니다.

segments.src: Here is how the formula works, why a raise can feel smaller than it looks, and what to watch next.
segments.tr: 여기 그 공식이 어떻게 작동하는지, 왜 인상액이 실제보다 적게 느껴질 수 있는지, 그리고 다음에 무엇을 지켜봐야 하는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not personal financial advice.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 하며 개인적인 재무 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Check the Social Security Administration (SSA) announcement for the official 2027 figure.*
segments.tr: 공식적인 2027년 수치는 사회보장국(SSA)의 발표를 확인하십시오.*

segments.src: ## What a COLA actually is
segments.tr: ## COLA란 무엇인가

segments.src: Social Security benefits are tied to inflation by law.
segments.tr: 사회보장 연금은 법에 따라 물가상승률과 연동됩니다.

segments.src: The goal of the COLA is simple: keep the purchasing power of benefits from eroding as prices rise.
segments.tr: COLA의 목적은 간단합니다. 물가가 상승함에 따라 연금의 구매력이 떨어지는 것을 막는 것입니다.

segments.src: Without it, a benefit that covers a given basket of goods today would cover less each year.
segments.tr: 이 제도가 없다면, 오늘 특정 상품 바구니를 구매할 수 있는 연금액은 매년 구매력이 줄어들게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: The COLA also applies to Supplemental Security Income (SSI) payments, so the same percentage reaches some of the lowest-income beneficiaries in the program.
segments.tr: COLA는 보충적 사회보장소득(SSI) 지급액에도 적용되므로, 동일한 비율이 프로그램 내 저소득 수급자 일부에게도 적용됩니다.

segments.src: ## The formula, step by step
segments.tr: ## 단계별 공식

segments.src: The adjustment is not based on a single month of data, and it is not based on the headline CPI that makes the news.
segments.tr: 조정액은 단 한 달의 데이터를 기준으로 하지 않으며, 뉴스에 나오는 헤드라인 CPI를 기준으로 하지도 않습니다.

segments.src: The process works like this:
segments.tr: 과정은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: 1. **The index used is the CPI-W.** That is the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). It is related to, but not identical to, the more widely quoted CPI-U.
segments.tr: 1. **사용되는 지수는 CPI-W입니다.** 이는 노동통계국(BLS)에서 발표하는 도시 임금 근로자 및 사무직 근로자를 위한 소비자물가지수입니다. 이는 더 널리 인용되는 CPI-U와 관련이 있지만 동일하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Only the third quarter counts.** The SSA takes the average CPI-W for July, August and September.
segments.tr: 2. **3분기 데이터만 계산에 포함됩니다.** 사회보장국(SSA)은 7월, 8월, 9월의 평균 CPI-W를 산출합니다.

segments.src: 3. **It compares that average with the prior year's third quarter.** If this year's average is higher than last year's, the percentage difference becomes the COLA.
segments.tr: 3. **해당 평균을 전년도 3분기와 비교합니다.** 올해 평균이 작년보다 높으면 그 차이만큼의 비율이 COLA가 됩니다.

segments.src: 4. **The result is rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent.**
segments.tr: 4. **결과는 소수점 첫째 자리까지 반올림됩니다.**

segments.src: 5. **If prices did not rise, there is no increase.** In that case benefits stay the same; they are not reduced.
segments.tr: 5. **물가가 오르지 않으면 인상도 없습니다.** 이 경우 연금액은 그대로 유지되며, 삭감되지는 않습니다.

segments.src: Because the September report supplies the last of the three monthly readings, the COLA can be calculated and announced as soon as that report is released, typically in mid-October.
segments.tr: 9월 보고서가 3개월치 데이터 중 마지막을 제공하기 때문에, COLA는 해당 보고서가 발표되는 즉시(보통 10월 중순) 계산 및 발표될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the raise can feel smaller than it looks
segments.tr: ## 인상액이 실제보다 적게 느껴지는 이유

segments.src: A headline percentage is only part of the story.
segments.tr: 헤드라인에 나오는 인상률은 전체 이야기의 일부일 뿐입니다.

segments.src: Several factors can make a COLA feel modest in practice.
segments.tr: 실제로는 여러 요인이 COLA를 미미하게 느끼게 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Medicare Part B premiums.** For most beneficiaries, the Part B premium is deducted directly from the Social Security check. When the premium rises, it can absorb a meaningful share of the increase. A "hold harmless" rule protects many people from a premium increase that would reduce their net benefit, but it does not apply to everyone, such as people newly enrolled or higher earners who pay income-related amounts.
segments.tr: - **메디케어 파트 B 보험료.** 대부분의 수급자에게 파트 B 보험료는 사회보장 연금 수령액에서 직접 공제됩니다. 보험료가 오르면 인상분의 상당 부분을 차지할 수 있습니다. "무해(hold harmless)" 규칙이 많은 사람을 순수령액을 줄이는 보험료 인상으로부터 보호하지만, 신규 가입자나 소득 관련 보험료를 납부하는 고소득자 등 모든 사람에게 적용되지는 않습니다.

segments.src: - **The index may not match your spending.** The CPI-W measures a broad basket of goods and services. Retirees often spend a larger share of their budgets on health care and housing than that basket reflects, so their personal inflation rate can differ from the national figure. Researchers have long debated whether an index designed specifically for older Americans would be more accurate.
segments.tr: - **지수가 귀하의 지출과 일치하지 않을 수 있습니다.** CPI-W는 광범위한 상품 및 서비스 바구니를 측정합니다. 은퇴자들은 종종 그 바구니가 반영하는 것보다 의료비와 주거비에 예산의 더 큰 비중을 지출하므로, 개인의 물가상승률은 국가 통계와 다를 수 있습니다. 연구자들은 고령 미국인을 위해 특별히 설계된 지수가 더 정확할지에 대해 오랫동안 논의해 왔습니다.

segments.src: - **Inflation is cumulative.** A COLA reflects the past year's price changes. If prices have risen for several years in a row, a single year's adjustment does not reverse the earlier increases in the cost of living.
segments.tr: - **물가상승은 누적됩니다.** COLA는 지난 1년간의 물가 변화를 반영합니다. 물가가 수년 연속으로 올랐다면, 단 한 해의 조정으로 이전의 생활비 상승분을 되돌릴 수는 없습니다.

segments.src: - **Taxes.** Depending on total income, up to 85 percent of Social Security benefits may be subject to federal income tax. The income thresholds that trigger this are not indexed to inflation, so a larger share of benefits can become taxable over time.
segments.tr: - **세금.** 총소득에 따라 사회보장 연금의 최대 85%가 연방 소득세 대상이 될 수 있습니다. 이를 유발하는 소득 기준은 물가와 연동되지 않으므로, 시간이 지남에 따라 연금의 더 많은 부분이 과세 대상이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Timing lag.** The adjustment is based on July-to-September data and takes effect in January, which means prices can keep moving in the months in between.
segments.tr: - **시차.** 조정은 7월부터 9월까지의 데이터를 기반으로 하며 1월부터 적용되는데, 이는 그 사이 몇 달 동안 물가가 계속 변동할 수 있음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: ## A quick illustration
segments.tr: ## 간단한 예시

segments.src: Suppose a retiree receives $2,000 a month and the COLA is 2.5 percent.
segments.tr: 한 은퇴자가 매달 2,000달러를 받고 COLA가 2.5%라고 가정해 봅시다.

segments.src: The gross increase would be $50 a month, bringing the benefit to $2,050.
segments.tr: 총 인상액은 월 50달러가 되어 연금액은 2,050달러가 됩니다.

segments.src: If the Medicare Part B premium rises by $15 that month and is deducted from the check, the net gain is closer to $35 before any tax effects.
segments.tr: 만약 그 달에 메디케어 파트 B 보험료가 15달러 인상되어 수령액에서 공제된다면, 세금 효과를 제외한 실질적인 증가액은 35달러에 가깝습니다.

segments.src: The exact numbers differ for every household, but the arithmetic shows why the gross and net figures can diverge.
segments.tr: 정확한 숫자는 가구마다 다르지만, 이 계산은 왜 총액과 실수령액이 다를 수 있는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: ## Other numbers that change in January
segments.tr: ## 1월에 변경되는 다른 숫자들

segments.src: The COLA announcement usually comes with other updates for the new year.
segments.tr: COLA 발표는 보통 새해를 위한 다른 업데이트와 함께 나옵니다.

segments.src: These commonly include:
segments.tr: 일반적으로 포함되는 내용은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **The taxable maximum.** This is the cap on earnings subject to the Social Security payroll tax. It typically rises each year with average wage growth.
segments.tr: - **과세 상한선.** 이는 사회보장 급여세가 부과되는 소득의 상한선입니다. 보통 매년 평균 임금 상승률에 따라 인상됩니다.

segments.src: - **The earnings test thresholds.** People who claim benefits before full retirement age and keep working may have benefits temporarily withheld above certain earnings limits.
segments.tr: - **소득 제한 기준.** 정년퇴직 연령 이전에 연금을 신청하고 계속 일하는 사람들은 특정 소득 한도를 초과할 경우 연금이 일시적으로 지급 정지될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **The quarter-of-coverage amount.** This determines the earnings needed to earn work credits.
segments.tr: - **근로 크레딧 산정 금액.** 이는 근로 크레딧을 얻기 위해 필요한 소득을 결정합니다.

segments.src: - **Medicare premiums and deductibles.** These are announced separately by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, usually in the fall.
segments.tr: - **메디케어 보험료 및 공제액.** 이는 보통 가을에 메디케어 및 메디케이드 서비스 센터(CMS)에서 별도로 발표합니다.

segments.src: ## What retirees should watch next
segments.tr: ## 은퇴자가 다음에 지켜봐야 할 것

segments.src: - **The official SSA announcement.** It usually follows the CPI release the same morning and is posted at ssa.gov.
segments.tr: - **공식 SSA 발표.** 보통 CPI 발표 당일 아침에 이어지며 ssa.gov에 게시됩니다.

segments.src: - **Your COLA notice.** The SSA typically sends notices to beneficiaries in December, and many people can see the details in their my Social Security online account.
segments.tr: - **COLA 통지서.** SSA는 보통 12월에 수급자에게 통지서를 보내며, 많은 사람이 my Social Security 온라인 계정에서 세부 정보를 확인할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **The Medicare Part B premium.** Compare it with your COLA to estimate your net change.
segments.tr: - **메디케어 파트 B 보험료.** COLA와 비교하여 실질적인 변화를 추정해 보십시오.

segments.src: - **Your withholding.** If you have federal income tax withheld from benefits, consider whether the new amount still matches your situation.
segments.tr: - **원천징수.** 연금에서 연방 소득세를 원천징수하고 있다면, 새로운 금액이 여전히 귀하의 상황에 맞는지 고려하십시오.

segments.src: - **The program's long-term finances.** The annual Trustees Report projects the funding outlook for the trust funds, which is a separate question from the COLA but one that shapes the wider debate over benefits.
segments.tr: - **프로그램의 장기 재정.** 연례 수탁자 보고서는 신탁 기금의 재정 전망을 예측하는데, 이는 COLA와는 별개의 문제이지만 연금에 대한 더 넓은 논의를 형성하는 요소입니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The 2027 COLA is a mechanical calculation: the average CPI-W for the third quarter compared with the same period a year earlier.
segments.tr: 2027년 COLA는 기계적인 계산입니다. 3분기 평균 CPI-W를 전년도 같은 기간과 비교하는 것입니다.

segments.src: The September CPI report completes that calculation.
segments.tr: 9월 CPI 보고서가 그 계산을 완료합니다.

segments.src: What matters to each household, however, is the net amount after Medicare premiums and taxes, and how it compares with the prices that household actually faces.
segments.tr: 하지만 각 가구에 중요한 것은 메디케어 보험료와 세금을 뺀 실수령액이며, 그것이 해당 가구가 실제로 직면한 물가와 어떻게 비교되는지입니다.

segments.src: Once the official figure is announced, reviewing your own budget against the new benefit amount is the most useful next step.
segments.tr: 공식 수치가 발표되면, 새로운 연금액에 맞춰 자신의 예산을 검토하는 것이 가장 유용한 다음 단계입니다.

segments.src: ## What a COLA actually is

segments.tr: 社会保障福利依法与通货膨胀挂钩。

segments.src: The goal of the COLA is simple: keep the purchasing power of benefits from eroding as prices rise.

segments.tr: 2. **仅计算第三季度。** SSA 取7月、8月和9月的平均 CPI-W。

segments.src: 3. **It compares that average with the prior year's third quarter.** If this year's average is higher than last year's, the percentage difference becomes the COLA.
segments.tr: 3. **将其与上一年度的第三季度平均值进行比较。** 如果今年的平均值高于去年的平均值，则百分比差异即为 COLA。

segments.src: 4. **The result is rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent.**
segments.tr: 4. **结果四舍五入到小数点后一位。**

segments.src: 5. **If prices did not rise, there is no increase.** In that case benefits stay the same; they are not reduced.

segments.tr: ## 为什么涨幅感觉比看上去要小

segments.tr: 头条百分比只是故事的一部分。

When the premium rises, it can absorb a meaningful share of the increase. A "hold harmless" rule protects many people from a premium increase that would reduce their net benefit, but it does not apply to everyone, such as people newly enrolled or higher earners who pay income-related amounts.
segments.tr: - **联邦医疗保险 B 部分（Medicare Part B）保费。** 对于大多数受益人来说，B 部分保费直接从社会保障支票中扣除。当保费上涨时，它可能会吸收相当大一部分的增长。“无害”（hold harmless）规则保护许多人免受会减少其净福利的保费上涨的影响，但这并不适用于所有人，例如新注册的人或支付与收入相关的金额的高收入者。

segments.src: - **The index may not match your spending.** The CPI-W measures a broad basket of goods and services. Retirees often spend a larger share of their budgets on health care and housing than that basket reflects, so their personal inflation rate can differ from the national figure. Researchers have long debated whether an index designed specifically for older Americans would be more accurate.
segments.tr: - **该指数可能与您的支出不符。** CPI-W 衡量的是广泛的一篮子商品和服务。退休人员预算中用于医疗保健和住房的份额通常比该一篮子商品所反映的要大，因此他们的个人通胀率可能与国家数据不同。研究人员长期以来一直在争论专门为老年美国人设计的指数是否会更准确。

segments.src: - **Inflation is cumulative.** A COLA reflects the past year's price changes. If prices have risen for several years in a row, a single year's adjustment does not reverse the earlier increases in the cost of living.
segments.tr: - **通货膨胀是累积的。** COLA 反映了过去一年的价格变化。如果价格连续几年上涨，单年的调整并不会扭转早期生活成本的上涨。

segments.src: - **Taxes.** Depending on total income, up to 85 percent of Social Security benefits may be subject to federal income tax. The income thresholds that trigger this are not indexed to inflation, so a larger share of benefits can become taxable over time.
segments.tr: - **税收。** 根据总收入，高达85%的社会保障福利可能需要缴纳联邦所得税。触发这一点的收入门槛没有根据通胀进行指数化调整，因此随着时间的推移，更大比例的福利可能会成为应税福利。

segments.src: - **Timing lag.** The adjustment is based on July-to-September data and takes effect in January, which means prices can keep moving in the months in between.
segments.tr: - **时间滞后。** 调整基于7月至9月的数据，并于1月生效，这意味着价格在中间的几个月里可能会继续变动。

segments.src: ## A quick illustration
segments.tr: ## 一个简单的图解

segments.src: Suppose a retiree receives $2,000 a month and the COLA is 2.5 percent.
segments.tr: 假设一位退休人员每月领 $2,000，COLA 为 2.5%。

segments.src: The gross increase would be $50 a month, bringing the benefit to $2,050.
segments.tr: 总增幅将是每月 $50，使福利达到 $2,050。

segments.src: If the Medicare Part B premium rises by $15 that month and is deducted from the check, the net gain is closer to $35 before any tax effects.
segments.tr: 如果联邦医疗保险 B 部分保费当月上涨 $15 并从支票中扣除，在产生任何税收效应之前，净增益接近 $35。

segments.src: The exact numbers differ for every household, but the arithmetic shows why the gross and net figures can diverge.
segments.tr: 每个家庭的确切数字不同，但算术表明了为什么总额和净额数字会产生分歧。

segments.src: ## Other numbers that change in January
segments.tr: ## 1月改变的其他数字

segments.src: The COLA announcement usually comes with other updates for the new year.
segments.tr: COLA 公告通常伴随着新年的其他更新。

segments.src: These commonly include:
segments.tr: 这些通常包括：

segments.src: - **The taxable maximum.** This is the cap on earnings subject to the Social Security payroll tax. It typically rises each year with average wage growth.
segments.tr: - **应税最高限额。** 这是对受社会保障薪酬税约束的收益的上限。它通常随着平均工资增长每年上升。

segments.src: - **The earnings test thresholds.** People who claim benefits before full retirement age and keep working may have benefits temporarily withheld above certain earnings limits.
segments.tr: - **收入测试门槛。** 在达到全面退休年龄之前领取福利并继续工作的人可能会在超过某些收入限制时被暂时扣发福利。

segments.src: - **The quarter-of-coverage amount.** This determines the earnings needed to earn work credits.
segments.tr: - **保费季度（quarter-of-coverage）金额。** 这决定了赚取工作积分所需的收入。

segments.src: - **Medicare premiums and deductibles.** These are announced separately by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, usually in the fall.
segments.tr: - **联邦医疗保险保费和免赔额。** 这些由联邦医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services）分别宣布，通常在秋季。

segments.src: ## What retirees should watch next
segments.tr: ## 退休人员接下来应关注什么

segments.src: - **The official SSA announcement.** It usually follows the CPI release the same morning and is posted at ssa.gov.
segments.tr: - **官方 SSA 公告。** 它通常在 CPI 发布当天上午发布，并发布在 ssa.gov 上。

segments.src: - **Your COLA notice.** The SSA typically sends notices to beneficiaries in December, and many people can see the details in their my Social Security online account.
segments.tr: - **您的 COLA 通知。** SSA 通常在12月向受益人发送通知，许多人可以在其 my Social Security 在线账户中查看详细信息。

segments.src: - **The Medicare Part B premium.** Compare it with your COLA to estimate your net change.
segments.tr: - **联邦医疗保险 B 部分保费。** 将其与您的 COLA 进行比较，以估算您的净变化。

segments.src: - **Your withholding.** If you have federal income tax withheld from benefits, consider whether the new amount still matches your situation.
segments.tr: - **您的预扣税。** 如果您从福利中扣除联邦所得税，请考虑新金额是否仍符合您的现状。

segments.src: - **The program's long-term finances.** The annual Trustees Report projects the funding outlook for the trust funds, which is a separate question from the COLA but one that shapes the wider debate over benefits.
segments.tr: - **该计划的长期财务状况。** 年度受托人报告预测了信托基金的资金前景，这是一个与 COLA 分开的问题，但它塑造了关于福利的更广泛辩论。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The 2027 COLA is a mechanical calculation: the average CPI-W for the third quarter compared with the same period a year earlier.
segments.tr: 2027年的 COLA 是一项机械计算：第三季度的平均 CPI-W 与去年同期相比。

segments.src: The September CPI report completes that calculation.
segments.tr: 9月的 CPI 报告完成了该计算。

segments.src: What matters to each household, however, is the net amount after Medicare premiums and taxes, and how it compares with the prices that household actually faces.
segments.tr: 然而，对每个家庭重要的是扣除医疗保险保费和税款后的净额，以及它与该家庭实际上面对的价格的对比。

segments.src: Once the official figure is announced, reviewing your own budget against the new benefit amount is the most useful next step.
segments.tr: 一旦公布官方数字，根据新的福利金额审查您自己的预算是最有用的下一步。

hi.title: 2027 COLA आ रहा है: सितंबर की मुद्रास्फीति आपके सोशल सिक्योरिटी लाभ में वृद्धि कैसे निर्धारित करती है

segments.src: Every October, millions of Social Security beneficiaries wait for one number: the cost-of-living adjustment, or COLA, that will apply to their monthly benefit starting in January.
segments.tr: हर अक्टूबर, लाखों सोशल सिक्योरिटी लाभार्थी एक संख्या का इंतजार करते हैं: जीवन-यापन लागत समायोजन (cost-of-living adjustment), या COLA, जो जनवरी से उनके मासिक लाभ पर लागू होगा।

segments.src: This year, the final piece of that calculation arrives with the September Consumer Price Index (CPI) report.
segments.tr: इस वर्ष, उस गणना का अंतिम हिस्सा सितंबर की उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक (CPI) रिपोर्ट के साथ आता है।

segments.src: Here is how the formula works, why a raise can feel smaller than it looks, and what to watch next.
segments.tr: यहाँ बताया गया है कि यह फॉर्मूला कैसे काम करता है, वृद्धि दिखने में जितनी बड़ी लगती है उससे कम क्यों महसूस हो सकती है, और आगे क्या देखना है।

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not personal financial advice.
segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य जानकारी के लिए है और व्यक्तिगत वित्तीय सलाह नहीं है।

segments.src: Check the Social Security Administration (SSA) announcement for the official 2027 figure.*
segments.tr: आधिकारिक 2027 के आंकड़े के लिए सोशल सिक्योरिटी एडमिनिस्ट्रेशन (SSA) की घोषणा देखें।*

segments.src: ## What a COLA actually is
segments.tr: ## COLA वास्तव में क्या है

segments.src: Social Security benefits are tied to inflation by law.
segments.tr: सोशल सिक्योरिटी लाभ कानून द्वारा मुद्रास्फीति से जुड़े होते हैं।

segments.src: The goal of the COLA is simple: keep the purchasing power of benefits from eroding as prices rise.
segments.tr: COLA का लक्ष्य सरल है: कीमतों में वृद्धि के साथ लाभों की क्रय शक्ति को कम होने से बचाना।

segments.src: Without it, a benefit that covers a given basket of goods today would cover less each year.
segments.tr: इसके बिना, जो लाभ आज वस्तुओं की एक निश्चित टोकरी को कवर करता है, वह हर साल कम कवर करेगा।

segments.src: The COLA also applies to Supplemental Security Income (SSI) payments, so the same percentage reaches some of the lowest-income beneficiaries in the program.
segments.tr: COLA सप्लीमेंटल सिक्योरिटी इनकम (SSI) भुगतान पर भी लागू होता है, इसलिए वही प्रतिशत कार्यक्रम के कुछ सबसे कम आय वाले लाभार्थियों तक पहुंचता है।

segments.src: ## The formula, step by step
segments.tr: ## फॉर्मूला, चरण-दर-चरण

segments.src: The adjustment is not based on a single month of data, and it is not based on the headline CPI that makes the news.
segments.tr: समायोजन डेटा के एक महीने पर आधारित नहीं है, और यह उस मुख्य CPI पर आधारित नहीं है जो समाचारों में आता है।

segments.src: The process works like this:
segments.tr: यह प्रक्रिया इस तरह काम करती है:

segments.src: 1. **The index used is the CPI-W.** That is the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). It is related to, but not identical to, the more widely quoted CPI-U.
segments.tr: 1. **उपयोग किया जाने वाला सूचकांक CPI-W है।** यह शहरी वेतन भोगियों और लिपिक कर्मचारियों के लिए उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक है, जिसे श्रम सांख्यिकी ब्यूरो (BLS) द्वारा प्रकाशित किया जाता है। यह अधिक व्यापक रूप से उद्धृत CPI-U से संबंधित है, लेकिन उसके समान नहीं है।

segments.src: 2. **Only the third quarter counts.** The SSA takes the average CPI-W for July, August and September.
segments.tr: 2. **केवल तीसरी तिमाही की गणना की जाती है।** SSA जुलाई, अगस्त और सितंबर के लिए औसत CPI-W लेता है।

segments.src: 3. **It compares that average with the prior year's third quarter.** If this year's average is higher than last year's, the percentage difference becomes the COLA.
segments.tr: 3. **यह उस औसत की तुलना पिछले वर्ष की तीसरी तिमाही से करता है।** यदि इस वर्ष का औसत पिछले वर्ष से अधिक है, तो प्रतिशत अंतर COLA बन जाता है।

segments.src: 4. **The result is rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent.**
segments.tr: 4. **परिणाम को प्रतिशत के निकटतम दसवें हिस्से तक पूर्णांकित किया जाता है।**

segments.src: 5. **If prices did not rise, there is no increase.** In that case benefits stay the same; they are not reduced.
segments.tr: 5. **यदि कीमतें नहीं बढ़ीं, तो कोई वृद्धि नहीं होती है।** उस स्थिति में लाभ समान रहते हैं; उन्हें कम नहीं किया जाता है।

segments.src: Because the September report supplies the last of the three monthly readings, the COLA can be calculated and announced as soon as that report is released, typically in mid-October.
segments.tr: चूंकि सितंबर की रिपोर्ट तीन मासिक रीडिंग में से अंतिम प्रदान करती है, इसलिए COLA की गणना की जा सकती है और उस रिपोर्ट के जारी होते ही, आमतौर पर अक्टूबर के मध्य में, इसकी घोषणा की जा सकती है।

segments.src: ## Why the raise can feel smaller than it looks
segments.tr: ## वृद्धि दिखने में जितनी बड़ी लगती है उससे कम क्यों महसूस हो सकती है

segments.src: A headline percentage is only part of the story.
segments.tr: मुख्य प्रतिशत कहानी का केवल एक हिस्सा है।

segments.src: Several factors can make a COLA feel modest in practice.
segments.tr: कई कारक COLA को व्यवहार में मामूली महसूस करा सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Medicare Part B premiums.** For most beneficiaries, the Part B premium is deducted directly from the Social Security check. When the premium rises, it can absorb a meaningful share of the increase. A "hold harmless" rule protects many people from a premium increase that would reduce their net benefit, but it does not apply to everyone, such as people newly enrolled or higher earners who pay income-related amounts.
segments.tr: - **मेडिकेयर पार्ट बी प्रीमियम।** अधिकांश लाभार्थियों के लिए, पार्ट बी प्रीमियम सीधे सोशल सिक्योरिटी चेक से काट लिया जाता है। जब प्रीमियम बढ़ता है, तो यह वृद्धि का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा सोख सकता है। एक "होल्ड हार्मलेस" नियम कई लोगों को प्रीमियम वृद्धि से बचाता है जो उनके शुद्ध लाभ को कम कर देगा, लेकिन यह हर किसी पर लागू नहीं होता है, जैसे कि नए नामांकित लोग या उच्च आय वाले लोग जो आय-संबंधी राशि का भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: - **The index may not match your spending.** The CPI-W measures a broad basket of goods and services. Retirees often spend a larger share of their budgets on health care and housing than that basket reflects, so their personal inflation rate can differ from the national figure. Researchers have long debated whether an index designed specifically for older Americans would be more accurate.
segments.tr: - **सूचकांक आपके खर्च से मेल नहीं खा सकता है।** CPI-W वस्तुओं और सेवाओं की एक विस्तृत टोकरी को मापता है। सेवानिवृत्त लोग अक्सर अपने बजट का एक बड़ा हिस्सा स्वास्थ्य देखभाल और आवास पर खर्च करते हैं जो उस टोकरी में परिलक्षित नहीं होता है, इसलिए उनकी व्यक्तिगत मुद्रास्फीति दर राष्ट्रीय आंकड़े से भिन्न हो सकती है। शोधकर्ताओं ने लंबे समय से बहस की है कि क्या विशेष रूप से वृद्ध अमेरिकियों के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया सूचकांक अधिक सटीक होगा।

segments.src: - **Inflation is cumulative.** A COLA reflects the past year's price changes. If prices have risen for several years in a row, a single year's adjustment does not reverse the earlier increases in the cost of living.
segments.tr: - **मुद्रास्फीति संचयी है।** COLA पिछले वर्ष के मूल्य परिवर्तनों को दर्शाता है। यदि कीमतें लगातार कई वर्षों से बढ़ रही हैं, तो एक वर्ष का समायोजन जीवन-यापन की लागत में पहले की वृद्धि को उलट नहीं देता है।

segments.src: - **Taxes.** Depending on total income, up to 85 percent of Social Security benefits may be subject to federal income tax. The income thresholds that trigger this are not indexed to inflation, so a larger share of benefits can become taxable over time.
segments.tr: - **कर।** कुल आय के आधार पर, सोशल सिक्योरिटी लाभ का 85 प्रतिशत तक संघीय आयकर के अधीन हो सकता है। इसे ट्रिगर करने वाली आय सीमाएं मुद्रास्फीति के अनुरूप अनुक्रमित नहीं हैं, इसलिए समय के साथ लाभ का एक बड़ा हिस्सा कर योग्य हो सकता है।

segments.src: - **Timing lag.** The adjustment is based on July-to-September data and takes effect in January, which means prices can keep moving in the months in between.
segments.tr: - **समय अंतराल।** समायोजन जुलाई-से-सितंबर के डेटा पर आधारित है और जनवरी में प्रभावी होता है, जिसका अर्थ है कि कीमतें बीच के महीनों में बढ़ती रह सकती हैं।

segments.src: ## A quick illustration
segments.tr: ## एक त्वरित उदाहरण

segments.src: Suppose a retiree receives $2,000 a month and the COLA is 2.5 percent.
segments.tr: मान लीजिए कि एक सेवानिवृत्त व्यक्ति को $2,000 प्रति माह मिलते हैं और COLA 2.5 प्रतिशत है।

segments.src: The gross increase would be $50 a month, bringing the benefit to $2,050.
segments.tr: सकल वृद्धि $50 प्रति माह होगी, जिससे लाभ $2,050 हो जाएगा।

segments.src: If the Medicare Part B premium rises by $15 that month and is deducted from the check, the net gain is closer to $35 before any tax effects.
segments.tr: यदि उस महीने मेडिकेयर पार्ट बी प्रीमियम $15 बढ़ जाता है और चेक से काट लिया जाता है, तो किसी भी कर प्रभाव से पहले शुद्ध लाभ $35 के करीब होता है।

segments.src: The exact numbers differ for every household, but the arithmetic shows why the gross and net figures can diverge.
segments.tr: सटीक संख्याएं हर घर के लिए अलग होती हैं, लेकिन अंकगणित दिखाता है कि सकल और शुद्ध आंकड़े क्यों भिन्न हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Other numbers that change in January
segments.tr: ## अन्य संख्याएं जो जनवरी में बदलती हैं

segments.src: The COLA announcement usually comes with other updates for the new year.
segments.tr: COLA घोषणा आमतौर पर नए साल के लिए अन्य अपडेट के साथ आती है।

es.title: El COLA de 2027 se acerca: Cómo la inflación de septiembre determina su aumento del Seguro Social

segments.src: Every October, millions of Social Security beneficiaries wait for one number: the cost-of-living adjustment, or COLA, that will apply to their monthly benefit starting in January.
segments.tr: Cada mes de octubre, millones de beneficiarios del Seguro Social esperan un solo número: el ajuste por costo de vida, o COLA, que se aplicará a su beneficio mensual a partir de enero.

segments.src: This year, the final piece of that calculation arrives with the September Consumer Price Index (CPI) report.
segments.tr: Este año, la última pieza de ese cálculo llega con el informe del Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) de septiembre.

segments.src: Here is how the formula works, why a raise can feel smaller than it looks, and what to watch next.
segments.tr: Aquí se explica cómo funciona la fórmula, por qué un aumento puede parecer menor de lo que aparenta y qué vigilar a continuación.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not personal financial advice.
segments.tr: *Este artículo es solo para información general y no constituye asesoramiento financiero personal.

segments.src: Check the Social Security Administration (SSA) announcement for the official 2027 figure.*
segments.tr: Consulte el anuncio de la Administración del Seguro Social (SSA) para obtener la cifra oficial de 2027.*

segments.src: ## What a COLA actually is
segments.tr: ## Qué es realmente un COLA

segments.src: Social Security benefits are tied to inflation by law.
segments.tr: Los beneficios del Seguro Social están vinculados a la inflación por ley.

segments.src: The goal of the COLA is simple: keep the purchasing power of benefits from eroding as prices rise.
segments.tr: El objetivo del COLA es simple: evitar que el poder adquisitivo de los beneficios se erosione a medida que los precios suben.

segments.src: Without it, a benefit that covers a given basket of goods today would cover less each year.
segments.tr: Sin él, un beneficio que hoy cubre una determinada cesta de bienes cubriría menos cada año.

segments.src: The COLA also applies to Supplemental Security Income (SSI) payments, so the same percentage reaches some of the lowest-income beneficiaries in the program.
segments.tr: El COLA también se aplica a los pagos de la Seguridad de Ingreso Suplementario (SSI), por lo que el mismo porcentaje llega a algunos de los beneficiarios con menores ingresos del programa.

segments.src: ## The formula, step by step
segments.tr: ## La fórmula, paso a paso

segments.src: The adjustment is not based on a single month of data, and it is not based on the headline CPI that makes the news.
segments.tr: El ajuste no se basa en un solo mes de datos, ni se basa en el IPC general que aparece en las noticias.

segments.src: The process works like this:
segments.tr: El proceso funciona así:

segments.src: 1. **The index used is the CPI-W.** That is the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). It is related to, but not identical to, the more widely quoted CPI-U.
segments.tr: 1. **El índice utilizado es el CPI-W.** Ese es el Índice de Precios al Consumidor para Asalariados Urbanos y Trabajadores Clericales, publicado por la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales (BLS). Está relacionado con, pero no es idéntico a, el CPI-U, que se cita más ampliamente.

segments.src: 2. **Only the third quarter counts.** The SSA takes the average CPI-W for July, August and September.
segments.tr: 2. **Solo cuenta el tercer trimestre.** La SSA toma el promedio del CPI-W para julio, agosto y septiembre.

segments.src: 3. **It compares that average with the prior year's third quarter.** If this year's average is higher than last year's, the percentage difference becomes the COLA.
segments.tr: 3. **Compara ese promedio con el tercer trimestre del año anterior.** Si el promedio de este año es mayor que el del año pasado, la diferencia porcentual se convierte en el COLA.

segments.src: 4. **The result is rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent.**
segments.tr: 4. **El resultado se redondea a la décima de porcentaje más cercana.**

segments.src: 5. **If prices did not rise, there is no increase.** In that case benefits stay the same; they are not reduced.
segments.tr: 5. **Si los precios no subieron, no hay aumento.** En ese caso, los beneficios se mantienen igual; no se reducen.

segments.src: Because the September report supplies the last of the three monthly readings, the COLA can be calculated and announced as soon as that report is released, typically in mid-October.
segments.tr: Debido a que el informe de septiembre proporciona la última de las tres lecturas mensuales, el COLA se puede calcular y anunciar tan pronto como se publique dicho informe, típicamente a mediados de octubre.

segments.src: ## Why the raise can feel smaller than it looks
segments.tr: ## Por qué el aumento puede parecer menor de lo que aparenta

segments.src: A headline percentage is only part of the story.
segments.tr: Un porcentaje general es solo una parte de la historia.

segments.src: Several factors can make a COLA feel modest in practice.
segments.tr: Varios factores pueden hacer que un COLA parezca modesto en la práctica.

segments.src: - **Medicare Part B premiums.** For most beneficiaries, the Part B premium is deducted directly from the Social Security check. When the premium rises, it can absorb a meaningful share of the increase. A "hold harmless" rule protects many people from a premium increase that would reduce their net benefit, but it does not apply to everyone, such as people newly enrolled or higher earners who pay income-related amounts.
segments.tr: - **Primas de la Parte B de Medicare.** Para la mayoría de los beneficiarios, la prima de la Parte B se deduce directamente del cheque del Seguro Social. Cuando la prima sube, puede absorber una parte significativa del aumento. Una regla de "no perjuicio" protege a muchas personas de un aumento en la prima que reduciría su beneficio neto, pero no se aplica a todos, como las personas recién inscritas o los contribuyentes de mayores ingresos que pagan montos relacionados con sus ingresos.

segments.src: - **The index may not match your spending.** The CPI-W measures a broad basket of goods and services. Retirees often spend a larger share of their budgets on health care and housing than that basket reflects, so their personal inflation rate can differ from the national figure. Researchers have long debated whether an index designed specifically for older Americans would be more accurate.
segments.tr: - **Es posible que el índice no coincida con sus gastos.** El CPI-W mide una cesta amplia de bienes y servicios. Los jubilados a menudo gastan una mayor proporción de sus presupuestos en atención médica y vivienda de lo que refleja esa cesta, por lo que su tasa de inflación personal puede diferir de la cifra nacional. Los investigadores llevan mucho tiempo debatiendo si un índice diseñado específicamente para estadounidenses mayores sería más preciso.

segments.src: - **Inflation is cumulative.** A COLA reflects the past year's price changes. If prices have risen for several years in a row, a single year's adjustment does not reverse the earlier increases in the cost of living.
segments.tr: - **La inflación es acumulativa.** Un COLA refleja los cambios de precios del año pasado. Si los precios han subido durante varios años seguidos, el ajuste de un solo año no revierte los aumentos anteriores en el costo de vida.

segments.src: - **Taxes.** Depending on total income, up to 85 percent of Social Security benefits may be subject to federal income tax. The income thresholds that trigger this are not indexed to inflation, so a larger share of benefits can become taxable over time.
segments.tr: - **Impuestos.** Dependiendo del ingreso total, hasta el 85 por ciento de los beneficios del Seguro Social pueden estar sujetos al impuesto federal sobre la renta. Los umbrales de ingresos que activan esto no están indexados a la inflación, por lo que una mayor proporción de los beneficios puede volverse gravable con el tiempo.

segments.src: - **Timing lag.** The adjustment is based on July-to-September data and takes effect in January, which means prices can keep moving in the months in between.
segments.tr: - **Desfase temporal.** El ajuste se basa en los datos de julio a septiembre y entra en vigor en enero, lo que significa que los precios pueden seguir moviéndose en los meses intermedios.

segments.src: ## A quick illustration
segments.tr: ## Una ilustración rápida

segments.src: Suppose a retiree receives $2,000 a month and the COLA is 2.5 percent.
segments.tr: Supongamos que un jubilado recibe $2,000 al mes y el COLA es del 2.5 por ciento.

segments.src: The gross increase would be $50 a month, bringing the benefit to $2,050.
segments.tr: El aumento bruto sería de $50 al mes, elevando el beneficio a $2,050.

segments.src: If the Medicare Part B premium rises by $15 that month and is deducted from the check, the net gain is closer to $35 before any tax effects.
segments.tr: Si la prima de la Parte B de Medicare aumenta en $15 ese mes y se deduce del cheque, la ganancia neta se acerca a los $35 antes de cualquier efecto fiscal.

segments.src: The exact numbers differ for every household, but the arithmetic shows why the gross and net figures can diverge.
segments.tr: Las cifras exactas difieren para cada hogar, pero la aritmética muestra por qué las cifras brutas y netas pueden divergir.

segments.src: ## Other numbers that change in January
segments.tr: ## Otras cifras que cambian en enero

segments.src: The COLA announcement usually comes with other updates for the new year.
segments.tr: El anuncio del COLA generalmente viene acompañado de otras actualizaciones para el nuevo año.

segments.src: These commonly include:
segments.tr: Estas comúnmente incluyen:

segments.src: - **The taxable maximum.** This is the cap on earnings subject to the Social Security payroll tax. It typically rises each year with average wage growth.
segments.tr: - **El máximo gravable.** Este es el límite de las ganancias sujeto al impuesto sobre la nómina del Seguro Social. Típicamente aumenta cada año con el crecimiento promedio de los salarios.

segments.src: - **The earnings test thresholds.** People who claim benefits before full retirement age and keep working may have benefits temporarily withheld above certain earnings limits.
segments.tr: - **Los umbrales de la prueba de ingresos.** Las personas que reclaman beneficios antes de la edad plena de jubilación y continúan trabajando pueden ver sus beneficios retenidos temporalmente por encima de ciertos límites de ganancias.

segments.src: - **The quarter-of-coverage amount.** This determines the earnings needed to earn work credits.
segments.tr: - **El monto del trimestre de cobertura.** Esto determina las ganancias necesarias para obtener créditos de trabajo.

segments.src: - **Medicare premiums and deductibles.** These are announced separately by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, usually in the fall.
segments.tr: - **Primas y deducibles de Medicare.** Estos son anunciados por separado por los Centros de Servicios de Medicare y Medicaid, generalmente en el otoño.

segments.src: ## What retirees should watch next
segments.tr: ## Qué deben vigilar los jubilados a continuación

segments.src: - **The official SSA announcement.** It usually follows the CPI release the same morning and is posted at ssa.gov.
segments.tr: - **El anuncio oficial de la SSA.** Por lo general, sigue a la publicación del IPC la misma mañana y se publica en ssa.gov.

segments.src: - **Your COLA notice.** The SSA typically sends notices to beneficiaries in December, and many people can see the details in their my Social Security online account.
segments.tr: - **Su aviso de COLA.** La SSA generalmente envía avisos a los beneficiarios en diciembre, y muchas personas pueden ver los detalles en su cuenta en línea de my Social Security.

segments.src: - **The Medicare Part B premium.** Compare it with your COLA to estimate your net change.
segments.tr: - **La prima de la Parte B de Medicare.** Compárela con su COLA para estimar su cambio neto.

segments.src: - **Your withholding.** If you have federal income tax withheld from benefits, consider whether the new amount still matches your situation.
segments.tr: - **Su retención de impuestos.** Si le retienen el impuesto federal sobre la renta de sus beneficios, considere si el nuevo monto aún se adapta a su situación.

segments.src: - **The program's long-term finances.** The annual Trustees Report projects the funding outlook for the trust funds, which is a separate question from the COLA but one that shapes the wider debate over benefits.
segments.tr: - **Las finanzas a largo plazo del programa.** El Informe anual de los Fideicomisarios proyecta las perspectivas de financiación de los fondos fiduciarios, lo cual es una cuestión separada del COLA pero que da forma al debate más amplio sobre los beneficios.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: The 2027 COLA is a mechanical calculation: the average CPI-W for the third quarter compared with the same period a year earlier.
segments.tr: El COLA de 2027 es un cálculo mecánico: el promedio del CPI-W para el tercer trimestre en comparación con el mismo período del año anterior.

segments.src: The September CPI report completes that calculation.
segments.tr: El informe del IPC de septiembre completa ese cálculo.

segments.src: What matters to each household, however, is the net amount after Medicare premiums and taxes, and how it compares with the prices that household actually faces.
segments.tr: Lo que importa para cada hogar, sin embargo, es el monto neto después de las primas de Medicare y los impuestos, y cómo se compara con los precios que ese hogar realmente enfrenta.

segments.src: Once the official figure is announced, reviewing your own budget against the new benefit amount is the most useful next step.
segments.tr: Una vez que se anuncie la cifra oficial, revisar su propio presupuesto en comparación con el nuevo monto del beneficio es el siguiente paso más útil.

segments.src: The process works like this:

segments.src: 3. **It compares that average with the prior year's third quarter.** If this year's average is higher than last year's, the percentage difference becomes the COLA.

segments.src: 5. **If prices did not rise, there is no increase.** In that case benefits stay the same; they are not reduced.
segments.tr: 5. **إذا لم ترتفع الأسعار، فلا توجد زيادة.** في هذه الحالة تظل الفوائد كما هي؛ ولا يتم تخفيضها.

segments.src: Because the September report supplies the last of the three monthly readings, the COLA can be calculated and announced as soon as that report is released, typically in mid-October.

segments.src: ## Why the raise can feel smaller than it looks
segments.tr: ## لماذا قد تبدو الزيادة أصغر مما تبدو عليه

segments.src: A headline percentage is only part of the story.
segments.tr: النسبة المئوية الرئيسية هي جزء فقط من القصة.

segments.src: Several factors can make a COLA feel modest in practice.
segments.tr: يمكن لعدة عوامل أن تجعل تعديل تكلفة المعيشة يبدو متواضعاً من الناحية العملية.

segments.src: - **Medicare Part B premiums.** For most beneficiaries, the Part B premium is deducted directly from the Social Security check. When the premium rises, it can absorb a meaningful share of the increase. A "hold harmless" rule protects many people from a premium increase that would reduce their net benefit, but it does not apply to everyone, such as people newly enrolled or higher earners who pay income-related amounts.
segments.tr: - **أقساط Medicare الجزء B.** بالنسبة لمعظم المستفيدين، يتم خصم قسط الجزء B مباشرة من شيك الضمان الاجتماعي. عندما يرتفع القسط، يمكنه استهلاك حصة كبيرة من الزيادة. تحمي قاعدة "عدم الإضرار" العديد من الأشخاص من زيادة القسط التي من شأنها تقليل صافيbenefit، ولكنها لا تنطبق على الجميع، مثل الأشخاص المسجلين حديثاً أو أصحاب الدخل الأعلى الذين يدفعون مبالغ مرتبطة بالدخل.

segments.src: - **The index may not match your spending.** The CPI-W measures a broad basket of goods and services. Retirees often spend a larger share of their budgets on health care and housing than that basket reflects, so their personal inflation rate can differ from the national figure. Researchers have long debated whether an index designed specifically for older Americans would be more accurate.
segments.tr: - **قد لا يتطابق المؤشر مع إنفاقك.** يقيس مؤشر CPI-W سلة واسعة من السلع والخدمات. غالباً ما ينفق المتقاعدون حصة أكبر من ميزانياتهم على الرعاية الصحية والإسكان مما تعكسه تلك السلة، لذلك يمكن أن يختلف معدل التضخم الشخصي عن الرقم الوطني. ناقش الباحثون لفترة طويلة ما إذا كان المؤشر المصمم خصيصاً لكبار السن الأمريكيين سيكون أكثر دقة.

segments.src: - **Inflation is cumulative.** A COLA reflects the past year's price changes. If prices have risen for several years in a row, a single year's adjustment does not reverse the earlier increases in the cost of living.
segments.tr: - **التضخم تراكمي.** يعكس تعديل تكلفة المعيشة تغيرات الأسعار في العام الماضي. إذا ارتفعت الأسعار لعدة سنوات متتالية، فإن تعديل العام الواحد لا يعكس الزيادات السابقة في تكلفة المعيشة.

segments.src: - **Taxes.** Depending on total income, up to 85 percent of Social Security benefits may be subject to federal income tax. The income thresholds that trigger this are not indexed to inflation, so a larger share of benefits can become taxable over time.
segments.tr: - **الضرائب.** اعتماداً على إجمالي الدخل، قد يخضع ما يصل إلى 85 بالمائة من مزايا الضمان الاجتماعي لضريبة الدخل الفيدرالية. عتبات الدخل التي تطلق ذلك لا تتم فهرستها للتضخم، لذلك يمكن أن تصبح حصة أكبر من المزايا خاضعة للضريبة بمرور الوقت.

segments.src: - **Timing lag.** The adjustment is based on July-to-September data and takes effect in January, which means prices can keep moving in the months in between.

segments.src: ## A quick illustration

segments.tr: - **الحد الأقصى الخاضع للضريبة.** هذا هو الحد الأقصى للأرباح الخاضعة لضريبة رواتب الضمان الاجتماعي. وعادة ما يرتفع كل عام مع نمو الأجور المتوسط.

segments.src: ## The bottom line

fr.title: Le COLA de 2027 arrive : comment l'inflation de septembre détermine votre augmentation de Sécurité sociale

segments.src: Every October, millions of Social Security beneficiaries wait for one number: the cost-of-living adjustment, or COLA, that will apply to their monthly benefit starting in January.
segments.tr: Chaque mois d'octobre, des millions de bénéficiaires de la Sécurité sociale attendent un chiffre : l'ajustement du coût de la vie, ou COLA, qui s'appliquera à leur prestation mensuelle à partir de janvier.

segments.src: This year, the final piece of that calculation arrives with the September Consumer Price Index (CPI) report.
segments.tr: Cette année, la dernière pièce de ce calcul arrive avec le rapport de l'indice des prix à la consommation (IPC) de septembre.

segments.src: Here is how the formula works, why a raise can feel smaller than it looks, and what to watch next.
segments.tr: Voici comment fonctionne la formule, pourquoi une augmentation peut sembler plus modeste qu'elle n'en a l'air, et ce qu'il faut surveiller ensuite.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not personal financial advice.
segments.tr: *Cet article est fourni à titre d'information générale uniquement et ne constitue pas un conseil financier personnel.

segments.src: Check the Social Security Administration (SSA) announcement for the official 2027 figure.*
segments.tr: Consultez l'annonce de la Social Security Administration (SSA) pour obtenir le chiffre officiel de 2027.*

segments.src: ## What a COLA actually is
segments.tr: ## Qu'est-ce qu'un COLA en réalité

segments.src: Social Security benefits are tied to inflation by law.
segments.tr: Les prestations de la Sécurité sociale sont liées par la loi à l'inflation.

segments.src: The goal of the COLA is simple: keep the purchasing power of benefits from eroding as prices rise.
segments.tr: L'objectif du COLA est simple : empêcher que le pouvoir d'achat des prestations ne s'érode à mesure que les prix augmentent.

segments.src: Without it, a benefit that covers a given basket of goods today would cover less each year.
segments.tr: Sans lui, une prestation qui couvre un panier de biens donné aujourd'hui en couvrirait de moins en moins chaque année.

segments.src: The COLA also applies to Supplemental Security Income (SSI) payments, so the same percentage reaches some of the lowest-income beneficiaries in the program.
segments.tr: Le COLA s'applique également aux paiements du Supplemental Security Income (SSI), de sorte que le même pourcentage bénéficie à certains des foyers à plus faible revenu du programme.

segments.src: ## The formula, step by step
segments.tr: ## La formule, étape par étape

segments.src: The adjustment is not based on a single month of data, and it is not based on the headline CPI that makes the news.
segments.tr: L'ajustement ne repose pas sur un seul mois de données, et il ne se base pas sur l'IPC global qui fait la une des journaux.

segments.src: The process works like this:
segments.tr: Le processus fonctionne comme suit :

segments.src: 1. **The index used is the CPI-W.** That is the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). It is related to, but not identical to, the more widely quoted CPI-U.
segments.tr: 1. **L'indice utilisé est l'IPC-W.** Il s'agit de l'indice des prix à la consommation pour les salariés urbains et les employés de bureau (Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers), publié par le Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). Il est lié, mais non identique, à l'IPC-U, qui est plus largement cité.

segments.src: 2. **Only the third quarter counts.** The SSA takes the average CPI-W for July, August and September.
segments.tr: 2. **Seul le troisième trimestre compte.** La SSA prend la moyenne de l'IPC-W pour juillet, août et septembre.

segments.src: 3. **It compares that average with the prior year's third quarter.** If this year's average is higher than last year's, the percentage difference becomes the COLA.
segments.tr: 3. **Elle compare cette moyenne à celle du troisième trimestre de l'année précédente.** Si la moyenne de cette année est supérieure à celle de l'an dernier, la différence en pourcentage devient le COLA.

segments.src: 4. **The result is rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent.**
segments.tr: 4. **Le résultat est arrondi au dixième de pour cent le plus proche.**

segments.src: 5. **If prices did not rise, there is no increase.** In that case benefits stay the same; they are not reduced.
segments.tr: 5. **Si les prix n'ont pas augmenté, il n'y a pas d'augmentation.** Dans ce cas, les prestations restent les mêmes ; elles ne sont pas réduites.

segments.src: Because the September report supplies the last of the three monthly readings, the COLA can be calculated and announced as soon as that report is released, typically in mid-October.
segments.tr: Étant donné que le rapport de septembre fournit la dernière des trois lectures mensuelles, le COLA peut être calculé et annoncé dès la publication de ce rapport, généralement à la mi-octobre.

segments.src: ## Why the raise can feel smaller than it looks
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi l'augmentation peut sembler plus petite qu'elle n'en a l'air

segments.src: A headline percentage is only part of the story.
segments.tr: Un pourcentage affiché à la une n'est qu'une partie de l'histoire.

segments.src: Several factors can make a COLA feel modest in practice.
segments.tr: Plusieurs facteurs peuvent donner l'impression qu'un COLA est modeste en pratique.

segments.src: - **Medicare Part B premiums.** For most beneficiaries, the Part B premium is deducted directly from the Social Security check. When the premium rises, it can absorb a meaningful share of the increase. A "hold harmless" rule protects many people from a premium increase that would reduce their net benefit, but it does not apply to everyone, such as people newly enrolled or higher earners who pay income-related amounts.
segments.tr: - **Les primes de la partie B de Medicare.** Pour la plupart des bénéficiaires, la prime de la partie B est déduite directement du chèque de la Sécurité sociale. Lorsque la prime augmente, elle peut absorber une part significative de l'augmentation. Une règle dite « de non-aggravation » (hold harmless) protège de nombreuses personnes contre une hausse de prime qui réduirait leur prestation nette, mais elle ne s'applique pas à tout le monde, comme les nouveaux inscrits ou les hauts revenus qui paient des montants liés à leurs revenus.

segments.src: - **The index may not match your spending.** The CPI-W measures a broad basket of goods and services. Retirees often spend a larger share of their budgets on health care and housing than that basket reflects, so their personal inflation rate can differ from the national figure. Researchers have long debated whether an index designed specifically for older Americans would be more accurate.
segments.tr: - **L'indice peut ne pas correspondre à vos dépenses.** L'IPC-W mesure un large panier de biens et de services. Les retraités consacrent souvent une part plus importante de leur budget aux soins de santé et au logement que ne le reflète ce panier, de sorte que leur taux d'inflation personnel peut différer du chiffre national. Les chercheurs se demandent depuis longtemps si un indice conçu spécifiquement pour les Américains âgés serait plus précis.

segments.src: - **Inflation is cumulative.** A COLA reflects the past year's price changes. If prices have risen for several years in a row, a single year's adjustment does not reverse the earlier increases in the cost of living.
segments.tr: - **L'inflation est cumulative.** Un COLA reflète les variations de prix de l'année précédente. Si les prix ont augmenté plusieurs années de suite, l'ajustement d'une seule année n'inverse pas les hausses antérieures du coût de la vie.

segments.src: - **Taxes.** Depending on total income, up to 85 percent of Social Security benefits may be subject to federal income tax. The income thresholds that trigger this are not indexed to inflation, so a larger share of benefits can become taxable over time.
segments.tr: - **Les impôts.** Selon le revenu total, jusqu'à 85 pour cent des prestations de Sécurité sociale peuvent être soumis à l'impôt fédéral sur le revenu. Les seuils de revenu qui déclenchent cette imposition ne sont pas indexés sur l'inflation, de sorte qu'une part plus importante des prestations peut devenir imposable au fil du temps.

segments.src: - **Timing lag.** The adjustment is based on July-to-September data and takes effect in January, which means prices can keep moving in the months in between.
segments.tr: - **Le décalage temporel.** L'ajustement est basé sur les données de juillet à septembre et prend effet en janvier, ce qui signifie que les prix peuvent continuer d'évoluer au cours des mois intermédiaires.

segments.src: ## A quick illustration
segments.tr: ## Une illustration rapide

segments.src: Suppose a retiree receives $2,000 a month and the COLA is 2.5 percent.
segments.tr: Supposons qu'un retraité reçoive 2 000 $ par mois et que le COLA soit de 2,5 pour cent.

segments.src: The gross increase would be $50 a month, bringing the benefit to $2,050.
segments.tr: L'augmentation brute serait de 50 $ par mois, portant la prestation à 2 050 $.

segments.src: If the Medicare Part B premium rises by $15 that month and is deducted from the check, the net gain is closer to $35 before any tax effects.
segments.tr: Si la prime de la partie B de Medicare augmente de 15 $ ce mois-là et est déduite du chèque, le gain net est plus proche de 35 $ avant tout effet fiscal.

segments.src: The exact numbers differ for every household, but the arithmetic shows why the gross and net figures can diverge.
segments.tr: Les chiffres exacts diffèrent pour chaque foyer, mais l'arithmétique montre pourquoi les chiffres bruts et nets peuvent diverger.

segments.src: ## Other numbers that change in January
segments.tr: ## Autres chiffres qui changent en janvier

segments.src: The COLA announcement usually comes with other updates for the new year.
segments.tr: L'annonce du COLA s'accompagne généralement d'autres mises à jour pour la nouvelle année.

segments.src: These commonly include:
segments.tr: celles-ci incluent communément :

segments.src: - **The taxable maximum.** This is the cap on earnings subject to the Social Security payroll tax. It typically rises each year with average wage growth.
segments.tr: - **Le maximum imposable.** Il s'agit du plafond des gains soumis à la taxe sur les salaires de la Sécurité sociale. Il augmente généralement chaque année avec la croissance des salaires moyens.

segments.src: - **The earnings test thresholds.** People who claim benefits before full retirement age and keep working may have benefits temporarily withheld above certain earnings limits.
segments.tr: - **Les seuils du test des gains.** Les personnes qui demandent des prestations avant l'âge de la retraite à taux plein et qui continuent de travailler peuvent voir leurs prestations temporairement retenues au-delà de certaines limites de revenus.

segments.src: - **The quarter-of-coverage amount.** This determines the earnings needed to earn work credits.
segments.tr: - **Le montant du trimestre de couverture.** Cela détermine les gains nécessaires pour acquérir des crédits de travail.

segments.src: - **Medicare premiums and deductibles.** These are announced separately by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, usually in the fall.
segments.tr: - **Les primes et franchises de Medicare.** Celles-ci sont annoncées séparément par les Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, généralement à l'automne.

segments.src: ## What retirees should watch next
segments.tr: ## Ce que les retraités doivent surveiller ensuite

segments.src: - **The official SSA announcement.** It usually follows the CPI release the same morning and is posted at ssa.gov.
segments.tr: - **L'annonce officielle de la SSA.** Elle suit généralement la publication de l'IPC le même matin et est publiée sur ssa.gov.

segments.src: - **Your COLA notice.** The SSA typically sends notices to beneficiaries in December, and many people can see the details in their my Social Security online account.
segments.tr: - **Votre avis de COLA.** La SSA envoie généralement des avis aux bénéficiaires en décembre, et de nombreuses personnes peuvent consulter les détails dans leur compte en ligne my Social Security.

segments.tr: - **La prime de la partie B de Medicare.** Comparez-la avec votre COLA pour estimer votre variation nette.

segments.tr: - **Vos retenues à la source.** Si vous avez des impôts fédéraux sur le revenu retenus sur vos prestations, vérifiez si le nouveau montant correspond toujours à votre situation.

segments.tr: - **Les finances à long terme du programme.** Le rapport annuel des Trustees (Trustees Report) projette les perspectives de financement des fonds fiduciaires, ce qui est une question distincte du COLA mais qui façonne le débat plus large sur les prestations.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: The 2027 COLA is a mechanical calculation: the average CPI-W for the third quarter compared with the same period a year earlier.
segments.tr: Le COLA de 2027 est un calcul mécanique : la moyenne de l'IPC-W pour le troisième trimestre comparée à la même période de l'année précédente.

segments.src: The September CPI report completes that calculation.
segments.tr: Le rapport de l'IPC de septembre achève ce calcul.

segments.src: What matters to each household, however, is the net amount after Medicare premiums and taxes, and how it compares with the prices that household actually faces.
segments.tr: Ce qui compte pour chaque foyer, cependant, c'est le montant net après les primes Medicare et les impôts, et la façon dont il se compare aux prix auxquels ce foyer fait réellement face.
